name: minibrute-fm1
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
tagline: a Minibrute-style monosynth for the FM-1
description: An unofficial Minibrute-style monophonic synth for the FM-1, written from scratch and measured against Arturia's MiniBrute V: sawtooth with Ultrasaw, square with PWM, triangle with Metalizer, sub and noise; a resonant multimode filter with Brute Factor; two ADSRs, an LFO, vibrato, glide and a mod wheel on the ALGO knob.
credits: Built on fm1-base (MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp, after Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments.
